competences.description: Attacks the enemy target to put the enemy to sleep for 1 turn with a 10% chance and absorb the Attack Bar by 15% with a 30% chance. The damage increases accordingly to your Attack Speed.

effets.description: The target will be put to sleep and won't be able to attack. The sleeping target wakes up when attacked or damaged. In addition, you won't receive glancing Hits when you are attacked.
Steal ATB from the enemy and add it to yourself

competences.description: Puts all enemies to sleep for 1 turn with a 60% chance and inflicts 2 Continuous Damage for 2 turns with a 60% chance. Blocks enemies that are already asleep from removing harmful effects for 1 turn.

effets.description: The target will be put to sleep and won't be able to attack. The sleeping target wakes up when attacked or damaged. In addition, you won't receive glancing Hits when you are attacked.
The target's HP will be damaged by 5% of the MAX HP whenever the target's turn returns. (Ignores Defense)

Harmful effects cannot be removed while this effect is on. This effect will be removed first when a harmful effect removal skill is used, and other harmful effects can be removed afterwards. Does not apply to bosses.

competences.description: Attacks all enemies to put them to sleep for 2 turns and creates a Shield equal to 30% of your MAX HP on all allies for 3 turns. The damage increases according to your MAX HP.

effets.description: The target will be put to sleep and won't be able to attack. The sleeping target wakes up when attacked or damaged. In addition, you won't receive glancing Hits when you are attacked.
The Shield will absorb a fixed amount of damage.
